item.title: Albanian Ministry of Justice on fire as education protesters riot
item.description: Hundreds of students joined anti-government protests in Tirana, demanding education reforms.

item.title: North Korea tests two submarine-launched missiles, state media reports
item.description: The tests showcase North Korea's war deterrent capabilities in the region, KCNA says.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran vows to fight until US yields as ships sink in Hormuz
item.description: Iran says it does not seek an endless war, but vows to fight until the US accepts its demands as ships sink in Hormuz.

item.title: US destroys dhow suspected of Iranian command and control
item.description: The US says it destroyed an Iran-affiliated boat in the Gulf of Oman, accusing it of conducting surveillance.

item.title: Watch: Block of flats destroyed in Russian strikes on Ukraine
item.description: BBC Ukraine Correspondent Dan Johnson is in Kyiv, where at least three people were killed in overnight strikes.
